comparison.objective: Push a flush plate out by its relief and transfer it flat into a tray; candidate tunes and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR tests constrained pushing, acquiring an overhang, and pick/place; candidate tests recessed tool engagement, counterholding, fine rotation, locking, and repeated physical-cycle evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires the plate removed from its slot and laid flat in the tray; candidate requires two bounded-energy stops without bottoming or drift.
comparison.reason: Plate extraction/transfer and damper commissioning have different mechanisms and outcomes. No spec versions or precise tray/plate tolerances are given.
